description: Normalize Persian (Farsi) text: convert Arabic letter variants (ي, ك) to their Persian forms, unify ZWNJ and spacing, and map Arabic-Indic digits to Persian digits. Use it before indexing, searching or comparing Persian text so that lookalike spellings match. Returns the normalized string. ($0.01 per call, USDC on Base)

text.description: Persian (Farsi) text or value to process. Max 100000 characters.

name: fa_normalize
